text: Reflection-agent atomic handshake failure: reflection-agent may complete full analysis (writing to reflection-log.jsonl, producing report) but fail to return processedReflectionIds in TaskUpdate metadata. When this happens, reflection-spawn-request.json retains the processed IDs indefinitely, causing the Router to re-spawn reflection-agent on every subsequent prompt. Root cause: reflection-agent TaskUpdate(completed) was not called or did not include processedReflectionIds. Fix: always verify atomic handshake by checking reflection-spawn-request.json is cleared after reflection completes. Prevention: reflection-cleanup.cjs hook checks for processedReflectionIds in TaskUpdate metadata.

Canary-first framework rollout: when rolling out a new pattern to multiple SKILL.md files, start with the lowest-risk artifact (schema-creator: trivial NOTE-tier change), validate the pattern lands correctly, then expand to higher-impact artifacts. Evidence: eval framework rollout 2026-03-05 used schema-creator as canary before applying FULL/LIGHT tiers to 7 other creator skills.

Integration queue poisoning: post-creation-integration.cjs was writing unknown:unknown entries to integration-queue.jsonl for TaskUpdate events where the artifact could not be resolved. These phantom entries caused artifact-integrator to retry indefinitely. Fix: guard after extractArtifactId() returns unknown:unknown. Cleanup: clear existing stale entries.

Position-based replacement vs Global Regex: index-based replacement (sanitized.substring(start, end)) is precise for LLM-reported PII but fails when used with pattern matches that only report the FIRST occurrence. Global regex replacement must be used for deduplicated pattern matches to prevent leakage of subsequent occurrences. Fix implemented in PrivacyAirlock.js Stage 3.

AUTO_COMPRESSION_PHASE_3=1 env var is REQUIRED to enable compression-reminder.txt writes. Without it, token-saver 80K/120K/150K thresholds are doc-only with no enforcement hook. compression-trigger.cjs writes compression-reminder.txt only when this var is set. All references to automatic token-saver activation in agent prompts are inaccurate without this env var.

After any major CLAUDE.md structural rewrite (v2.x → v3.0.0 etc.), ALL creator skill post-creation checklists must be audited for stale section references. Sections get renamed/merged — e.g. Section 8.5 became @SKILL_CATALOG_TABLE.md, skill-catalog.md became @SKILL_CATALOG_TABLE.md. Stale refs survive in SKILL.md files and silently break creator workflows.
omega-claude-cli fails inside CronCreate fires due to nested session error. Use Task() to spawn subagents inside CronCreate tasks, not omega-claude-cli.

evolution-state-guard TOCTOU race: non-atomic writeFileSync creates race window for concurrent evolution processes. Fix: fs.openSync(path, wx) uses O_EXCL flag, atomic create-exclusive at OS level. Error handling: catch EEXIST specifically (err.code === EEXIST). Any state guard file preventing concurrent execution must use O_EXCL.

spawn-prompt-validator was fail-open: security hooks that catch unexpected errors and exit(0) create bypass vectors. Iron Law: security hooks must exit(2) in catch blocks (fail-closed). Advisory hooks (metrics, logging) may exit(0). Documented in .claude/rules/hooks.md fail-open vs fail-closed policy table.
